_note: Input-regime parameters for the held-out tests, fixed before any model run and never changed after looking at the data. They are a priori choices (round values from qualitative literature), not fits. Configuration-D parameters are untouched.
seed_convention: as src/sweep.py: ctx_seed = s, gpe_seed = 100 + s; network layout (seeds['loc'], seeds['conn']) fixed, i.e. the same 58 cells (12 PV+, 46 PV-) in every seed

H1_H2.why_20s: the reference features need >= 100 spikes / 99 ISIs; 20 s gives >= ~300 spikes at the PD rates (16-33 Hz). The rat trains are ~100 s; burst_share has length-dependent false positives (Poisson ~0.1 at 300 s), reported as a caveat

rationale.freq_hz: ~1 Hz cortical slow oscillation under urethane / ketamine anesthesia (Steriade et al. 1993; Magill et al. 2000 in rat STN-cortex recordings). Fixed from the literature, not from the held-out EEG
rationale.depth: 0.9: cortical output in down states is near silent; down-state rate = 10% of up-state rate
rationale.duty: 0.5: up and down states of similar duration at ~1 Hz
rationale.mean_preserved: the envelope is normalized to mean 1, so the calibrated mean cortical drive is unchanged
rationale.seed: slow-wave timing seed = ctx_seed (differs between seeds)

H3_slow_oscillation.beta_reference: GPe beta drive phase (common oscillator phase, saved per 1 ms step) and, as an EEG analogue, the cortical population arrival rate band-passed 13-30 Hz; both from the H1 runs (no slow oscillation)

H4_optogenetics.why_compressed: accepted by the user: the model's slowest processes are ~1 s (Ca, HCN, 20 ms GPe rate constant), so the response to a step input settles within 1 s; the data's 20 s within-block recovery and 10-20 s after-effects are not testable with this protocol

D2_gpe.label: D2-MSN, textbook route: GPe rate reduced
D2_gpe.rationale: iSPN/D2-MSN input targets prototypic GPe neurons strongly (Ketzef & Silberberg 2021, Neuron); 50% reduction of the GPe baseline rate is an a priori round value (no quantitative in vivo value extracted); the STN->GPe feedback stays active

D2_ctx.label: D2-MSN, alternative route: cortical/thalamic drive reduced
D2_ctx.rationale: iSPN activation suppresses many M1 neurons within ~100-200 ms (Oldenburg & Sabatini 2015, Neuron; ~46% of units modulated); 20% reduction of the cortical arrival rate is an a priori round value

D1_ctx.label: D1-MSN, textbook route: cortical/thalamic drive increased
D1_ctx.rationale: dSPN activation disinhibits thalamus and excites most M1 neurons (Oldenburg & Sabatini 2015); +25% of the cortical arrival rate is an a priori round value

H4_optogenetics.test: per cell, Wilcoxon signed-rank of the 2 s stim rate vs the 1 s pre rate over the 10 cycles, p < 0.01 (as the ChR2 analysis)

H5_primate_change.fixed: 2026-11-18, before the H5 healthy runs and before downloading the primate data

states.parkinsonian: the H1 runs (sweeps/out/heldout/H1_pd, hashes in results/heldout/H1/prediction.json), configuration D

H5_primate_change.analysis_window: t >= 0.5 s to the end of the run (20 s per cell and seed); the same window length (20 s) is used for the length-matched primate segments
H5_primate_change.isi_features: validation/heldout/metrics/spike_features.py definitions (rate, CV, LV, pause-time fraction = ISIs > 4x mean ISI, frac ISI < 10 ms, Poisson-surprise burst share), applied without the 100-spike inclusion rule; cells with < 20 spikes in the window are excluded and counted

oscillation_test.psd: Welch, Hann, nperseg 2048 bins, 50% overlap, of the mean-subtracted binned train
oscillation_test.windows_hz: 2 Hz windows with edges 3, 5, ..., 41 (window power = mean PSD in [lo, hi))
oscillation_test.surrogates: 200 ISI-shuffled trains (same ISIs, random order, same first spike), seed fixed per train
oscillation_test.criterion: oscillatory if any window exceeds the 99.9th percentile of that window's surrogate powers
oscillation_test.peak: centre of the significant window with the largest power / surrogate-median ratio

H5_primate_change.length_matching: each primate unit: >= 10 random 20 s segments (uniform start, seed fixed); per-unit value = median over segments (oscillatory if the majority of segments are); full-length values secondary
H5_primate_change.bootstrap: 10,000 resamples of units within each state (data); model = mean +- SD over seeds of the per-seed change of population medians
